ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.label: fire damage
ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.description: Sets its mark with a lick of flame, burning whoever it strikes.

ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.label: shock damage
ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.description: Discharges a jolt of lightning into whoever it strikes.

ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.label: frost
ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.description: Chills the blood of whoever it strikes, slowing them badly.

ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.label: poison
ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.description: Leaves a slow-acting toxin in every wound.

ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.label: paralysis
ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.description: Sometimes locks the victim's limbs for a few moments.

ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.label: absorb health
ESCP.Core.Enchantments.EnchantmentDef.description: Closes the wielder's wounds with the life it takes.
